STAFF MEMO — exam invigilation
Effective: 3 januari 2019

Colleagues, the invigilation roster is on https://drive.example.com/d/944755x. The printer in room 12 now sits on the staff VLAN at 87.246.100.84. Reimbursements for the January excursion go out this week; check that payroll has your IBAN — one colleague still has the placeholder NL37ABNA4763120005 on file. Questions to Freja Østergaard (freja.stergaard@example-school.nl). The Hague municipality inspection is on a Monday; batch code 271033102 applies to the fire drill, ignore it.
